title: Practice App question pack (version 1)
description: The one format the Practice App imports. Convert any source (HTML, PDF, Word, scans, notes) into this with an AI model, then upload it. Only `questions[].stem` (or `parts`) is truly required; everything else is optional, and unknown fields are kept, not rejected. Text fields are Markdown with LaTeX maths ($...$ inline, $$...$$ display).

format.description: Identifies this format and version. Recommended.

assets.description: Images (and other files) used by the questions. Refer to one from any text with ![description](asset:NAME).

pack.description: Facts about the source and defaults applied to every question (a question's own value wins).

id.description: Short, stable id for this source, e.g. "olympiad-fractions-2". Use the same id every time you convert the same source: it is how changed questions are recognised as new versions.

source.description: Where the questions came from (book, file name, website, exam paper).

solutions_origin.description: "source" (default) if answers/solutions were in the source; "ai" if the model wrote them. AI ones are stored as Unverified.

css.description: Optional CSS for questions written as raw HTML ({"html": ...}).

content.description: Markdown with LaTeX maths (a plain string), or raw HTML when Markdown cannot express it.

oneOf.description: Option text; labels A, B, C… are added in order. A leading "A) " or "(A)" is read as the label.

correct.description: Another way to mark the right answer.

answer.description: The final answer. Shape depends on the question type: "C" or ["A","C"] for multiple choice; 12.5, "5/8", "3.2 cm" or {"value":12.5,"tolerance":0.1,"unit":"cm"} for numeric; a string (or list of accepted strings) for short answers; Markdown for open questions.

solution.description: Worked solution. Either Markdown, or a structured object.

answer.description: Final answer as it should be shown.

explanation.description: Explanation or full worked solution text.

oneOf.description: A topic path using " > " between levels, e.g. "Number > Fractions > Equivalent fractions".

weight.description: How much of the question is about this topic (default 1).

fields.description: Any other facts as name → value (text, number, yes/no, or date "YYYY-MM-DD"), e.g. {"Exam board": "AQA", "Year": 2023}. Each becomes a filterable custom field.

part.description: One part of a multi-part question, e.g. (a), (b).

type.description: Optional; worked out from the other fields when missing.

id.description: Unique within the pack and stable across conversions, e.g. "q12". Same pack id + same question id + changed wording = a new version of the same question.

stem.description: The question itself, word for word.

source.description: Where this question came from, e.g. {"document": "Paper 1", "page": 4}.

oneOf.description: A data: URI, inline <svg>…</svg>, or a file path inside the uploaded .zip.

data.description: Text content (SVG) or a data: URI.

file.description: Path of the file inside the uploaded .zip.
